# 06 User Flows — Prospect PAL

## Flow 1: Build Workflow with AI

```
1. User → /dashboard
2. Click "Build New" → /workflows/new
3. Choose "AI Build"
4. Enter prompt: "When HubSpot deal closes, notify Slack #sales"
5. AI generates workflow preview (nodes shown)
6. User reviews → Edit or Accept
7. Save → Added to /workflows
8. Export to n8n (JSON download)
```

## Flow 2: Fix Broken Workflow

```
1. User → /fix (or modal from dashboard)
2. Paste broken JSON
3. AI analyzes → identifies error node
4. Shows: Problem + Fix + Explanation
5. User copies fixed JSON
6. Paste into n8n → Working
```

## Flow 3: Import & Analyze

```
1. User → /analyzer
2. Paste n8n JSON
3. Platform parses → shows node graph preview
4. Health check: missing credentials, dead nodes, optimization tips
5. Report: Issues list + severity (red/yellow/green)
6. Option to save to /workflows
```

## Flow 4: Template to Deploy

```
1. User → /templates
2. Filter by category (e.g., "Sales")
3. Click template → preview node graph
4. Click "Use Template"
5. Configure: webhook URL, credential selection
6. Review → Deploy
7. Export to n8n format
```

## Flow 5: Daily Health Check

```
1. Daily 6am (scheduled)
2. System → n8n API → fetches executions
3. Analyzes: totals, failures, trends
4. Generates email report
5. Sends to configured recipients
6. User views: /reports
```

## Flow 6: Onboarding

```
1. User → /signup
2. OAuth (Google/GitHub) or email
3. Complete profile (name, org)
4. Quickstart: "Import your first workflow" or "Browse templates"
5. Empty state dashboard with guidance
```

## Flow 7: Team Invite

```
1. Owner → /settings/team
2. Click "Invite"
3. Enter email → Select role
4. Send invite
5. Invitee gets email → Clicks → Joins org
```

## Flow 8: Credential Management

```
1. User → /settings/credentials
2. Add credential: service (n8n, Make, etc.)
3. Enter API key (encrypted)
4. Test connection
5. Credential available in workflows
```

# 08 PRD — Prospect PAL

## Problem

n8n users waste hours debugging workflows, building from scratch, and monitoring scattered executions across projects.

## Solution

A unified platform that lets users describe automations in plain English, get working workflows instantly, analyze their health, and monitor executions—all without wrestling with JSON.

## Requirements

### Functional

| ID | Requirement | Prio |
|----|-------------|------|
| F1 | Import n8n JSON → visualize node graph | P0 |
| F2 | AI analyze: detect missing credentials, dead nodes, errors | P0 |
| F3 | AI fix: paste broken JSON → get corrected version | P0 |
| F4 | AI build: describe in English → generate workflow | P0 |
| F5 | Template library: browse, preview, duplicate | P0 |
| F6 | Export: n8n, Make.com, Gumloop formats | P1 |
| F7 | Dashboard: execution stats, health overview | P0 |
| F8 | Daily/weekly email reports | P1 |
| F9 | Credential management (encrypted) | P0 |
| F10 | Team workspaces with permissions | P1 |

### Non-Functional

| ID | Requirement | Target |
|----|-------------|--------|
| NF1 | Page load | < 2s |
| NF2 | AI response | < 30s |
| NF3 | JSON analyze | < 10s |
| NF4 | Export | < 5s |
| NF5 | Uptime | 99.9% |
| NF6 | Security | SOC2 Type II |

## Success Metrics

- Time to first workflow: < 5 min
- NPS: > 50
- Weekly active: 70% of signups
- Churn: < 5% monthly

## Out of Scope

- Live execution (n8n keeps this)
- Make/Gumloop import (export only)
- Advanced version control
- Real-time collaboration

## Rollout

- Beta: 50 users
- Launch: Public
- Scale: 100 MAU → 1000 → 10000
"}

## Row Level Security (RLS)

```sql
-- Organizations: users can only see their org
CREATE POLICY org_isolation ON organizations
  USING (id IN (
    SELECT org_id FROM users WHERE id = current_user_id()
  ));

-- Workflows: org members can read, owner/admin can write
CREATE POLICY workflow_org ON workflows
  USING (org_id IN (
    SELECT org_id FROM users WHERE id = current_user_id()
  ));

-- Executions: same scope as parent workflow
CREATE POLICY execution_workflow ON executions
  USING (workflow_id IN (
    SELECT id FROM workflows WHERE org_id IN (
      SELECT org_id FROM users WHERE id = current_user_id()
    )
  ));

-- Credentials: org members can use, only owner/admin can manage
CREATE POLICY credential_org ON credentials
  USING (org_id IN (
    SELECT org_id FROM users WHERE id = current_user_id()
  ));
```

## Indexes

```sql
-- Workflow lookups
CREATE INDEX idx_workflows_org ON workflows(org_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_workflows_status ON workflows(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_workflows_created ON workflows(created_at DESC);

-- Execution queries
CREATE INDEX idx_executions_workflow ON executions(workflow_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_executions_status ON executions(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_executions_dates ON executions(started_at DESC);

-- Template search
CREATE INDEX idx_templates_category ON templates(category);
CREATE INDEX idx_templates_search ON templates USING gin(to_tsvector('english', name || ' ' || description));

-- Report scheduling
CREATE INDEX idx_reports_org ON reports(org_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_reports_schedule ON reports(schedule) WHERE schedule IS NOT NULL;
```

## JSON Schema

### Workflow JSON (n8n format)

```typescript
interface WorkflowNode {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  typeVersion: number;
  position: [number, number];
  parameters: Record<string, any>;
  credentials?: Record<string, { id: string; name: string }>;
}

interface WorkflowConnection {
  node: string;
  type: 'main' | 'error';
  index: number;
}

interface WorkflowJson {
  name: string;
  nodes: WorkflowNode[];
  connections: Record<string, { main: WorkflowConnection[][] }>;
  settings?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

## Retention Policy

- Executions: 90 days (auto-archive to S3)
- Workflow versions: keep all (lightweight)
- Reports: keep 365 days
- Credentials: permanent until deleted
- Audit logs: 2 years

| Method | Path | Description | Auth |

| POST | /api/ai/build | Generate from prompt | Bearer |
| POST | /api/ai/fix | Fix broken JSON | Bearer |
| POST | /api/ai/analyze | Analyze health | Bearer |

### Templates

| Method | Path | Description | Auth |
|--------|------|-------------|------|
| GET | /api/templates | List templates | Bearer |
| GET | /api/templates/:id | Get template | Bearer |

### Reports

| Method | Path | Description | Auth |
|--------|------|-------------|------|
| GET | /api/reports | List reports | Bearer |
| POST | /api/reports | Create report | Bearer |
| GET | /api/reports/:id | Get report | Bearer |
| DELETE | /api/reports/:id | Delete report | Bearer |

### Credentials

| Method | Path | Description | Auth |
|--------|------|-------------|------|
| GET | /api/credentials | List credentials | Bearer |
| POST | /api/credentials | Create credential | Bearer |
| DELETE | /api/credentials/:id | Delete credential | Bearer |
| POST | /api/credentials/:id/test | Test connection | Bearer |

## Error Format

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND",
    "message": "Workflow not found",
    "details": {},
    "request_id": "req_abc123"
  }
}
```

| Endpoint | Limit | Window |
|----------|-------|--------|
| AI build | 10 | 1 minute |
| AI fix | 20 | 1 minute |
| Standard | 100 | 1 minute |

## Idempotency

Include `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` header for POST requests. Keys valid for 24h.
